'''Merinda Niemeh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who was employed by the [[High King]] of [[Hargeeva]] to upgrade the technology in the [[Royal Palace]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During an uprising, she formed a friendship with the King's son, [[Stevan Makintay|Stevan]], and followed him when he joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she was stationed at [[Eyrie Base]].
